name: Virag Daily Social Design Trends
purpose: Translate current public visual-culture and social-design signals into original Instagram-ready art-direction principles without copying creators, brands or layouts.

sources.name: Pinterest Predicts 2026
sources.use: Primary annual forecast used to confirm the broader visual-culture signals.

sources.name: Pinterest Predicts 2026 — Neo Deco
sources.use: Evidence for disciplined geometric framing, polished structure and modern deco rhythm.

sources.name: Pinterest Predicts 2026 — Gimme Gummy
sources.use: Evidence for tactile, sensory material cues translated into controlled 3D and packaging detail.

sources.name: Pinterest Predicts 2026 — Poetcore
sources.use: Evidence for literary editorial styling, intimate crops and refined serif-led hierarchy.

sources.name: Pinterest Predicts 2026 — FunHaus
sources.use: Evidence for bold stripes and sculptural geometry, simplified into one directional system.

sources.name: Pinterest Palette 2026
sources.use: Primary color evidence for Cool Blue, Jade, Plum Noir, Wasabi and Persimmon.

sources.name: Pinterest Trends
sources.use: Live search-interest cross-check; directional evidence only, never a composition to copy.

sources.name: Instagram
sources.use: Public format observation for phone-scale hierarchy, short copy and immediate product recognition only.

selectionRule: For each requested output, choose at most one compatible active trend as an optional art-direction layer. Build one clear idea around one dominant product-and-headline relationship, intentional grid tension, short exact copy, 1–3 compact supporting information modules, no more than two professional named font families and three weights, and 2–5 coordinated graphic devices from one coherent visual language. In a batch, rotate through compatible trends without repeating until all have been used. A trend may shape grid, typography, palette, tactile detail, depth and restrained motion, but must never override the current brief, brand identity, two-second clarity, readable copy, Pixel-Locked Product Fidelity, Human Studio realism or Clean Human Design. Bright-first is the default unless dark styling is explicitly requested. Clean means edited and controlled, never sparse, basic, template-like or under-designed. If a trend reduces clarity, fidelity or coherence, omit or simplify it.

activeTrends.label: Neo-Deco Social Geometry
activeTrends.signal: Pinterest Predicts 2026 names Neo Deco as an emerging aesthetic, supporting polished geometry and structured decorative rhythm when simplified for social design.
activeTrends.layout: Use an asymmetric geometric frame, stepped alignment and one arch or fan motif around a dominant product-and-headline relationship; reserve 1–3 compact fact modules. In Video, reveal the geometry in one measured sequence rather than looping ornaments.
activeTrends.typography: Condensed grotesk or refined editorial serif paired with Inter/Helvetica-style utility copy.
activeTrends.palette: Brand palette first; optional jade, persimmon or pale blue accent.
activeTrends.texture: Subtle paper, brushed metal or print grain—never plastic gloss.
activeTrends.avoid: Literal 1920s imitation, ornamental overload and gold-on-black by default.

activeTrends.label: Tactile Material Edit
activeTrends.signal: Pinterest Predicts 2026’s Gimme Gummy signal foregrounds sensory, touchable materiality; translate it into controlled soft forms, physical texture and believable craft instead of synthetic AI gloss.
activeTrends.layout: Use one tactile form or imperfect mask as the spatial anchor, with edited cut shapes and compact information modules on a disciplined grid. In Video, favor slow compression, peel or parallax motion with believable material response.
activeTrends.typography: Real typesetting with one optional handwritten annotation accent; display and utility copy stay readable and use no more than two families.
activeTrends.palette: Brand colors first, supported by warm paper neutrals or one soft confectionery accent.
activeTrends.texture: Scanned fibers, soft-touch material, ink variation or subtle dimensional edges with realistic contact shadows.
activeTrends.avoid: Plastic AI sheen, literal candy imitation, fake scrapbook clutter, excessive torn paper and childish sticker overload.

activeTrends.label: Cool Blue Clarity
activeTrends.signal: Pinterest Palette 2026 identifies Cool Blue as a directional color; use it to support calm clarity while preserving exact brand and product colors.
activeTrends.layout: Use an airy but designed modular grid, one strong product anchor and 1–3 translucent or opaque information cards with deliberate overlap. In Video, use short linear card reveals and restrained depth shifts.
activeTrends.typography: Neutral modern sans with precise data hierarchy.
activeTrends.palette: Cool Blue #D7EFFF supported by navy, white and the exact brand colors.
activeTrends.texture: Soft matte surfaces and restrained translucency.
activeTrends.avoid: Generic SaaS glassmorphism, excessive blur and low-contrast text.

activeTrends.label: Persimmon Impact
activeTrends.signal: Pinterest Palette 2026 identifies Persimmon as a directional warm color, supporting controlled red-orange emphasis in high-clarity social compositions.
activeTrends.layout: Use one energetic diagonal or cropped color field to connect product and headline, balanced by stable fact modules. In Video, move the field once as a directional wipe or practical light cue.
activeTrends.typography: Bold condensed display type with disciplined small sans-serif facts.
activeTrends.palette: Persimmon #FF5C34 as an accent only, adapted to brand compatibility.
activeTrends.texture: Matte ink, screen-print density or practical colored light.
activeTrends.avoid: Full-canvas orange overload, fire effects and oversaturated AI glow.

activeTrends.label: Wasabi Utility Accent
activeTrends.signal: Pinterest Palette 2026 identifies Wasabi as a directional yellow-green; use it as a small functional visibility accent rather than a full visual identity.
activeTrends.layout: Use compact fact tags, ruled lines and one high-visibility CTA or data point in a tense utility grid. In Video, animate labels with quick, precise position changes and no neon pulsing.
activeTrends.typography: Industrial grotesk or mono accent paired with a clean brand sans.
activeTrends.palette: Wasabi #E9F056 used in small controlled areas with black, white or brand neutrals.
activeTrends.texture: Printed label stock, fabric weave or practical reflective material.
activeTrends.avoid: Gaming-neon clichés, black-and-green overload and illegible fluorescent body text.

activeTrends.label: Jade Organic Precision
activeTrends.signal: Pinterest Palette 2026 identifies Jade as a directional muted green, supporting natural wellbeing cues without generic eco styling.
activeTrends.layout: Use a structured editorial grid with one organic curve acting as a supporting divider or mask and 1–3 factual modules. In Video, use a slow shadow drift or restrained mask transition.
activeTrends.typography: Elegant humanist sans or restrained serif pairing.
activeTrends.palette: Jade #AEB8A0, warm white and exact product/brand colors.
activeTrends.texture: Natural fibers, stone, uncoated stock or subtle botanical shadow.
activeTrends.avoid: Generic leaf borders, scattered ingredients and fake eco claims.

activeTrends.label: Poet Editorial
activeTrends.signal: Pinterest Predicts 2026’s Poetcore signal supports literary, personal-expression aesthetics; translate it into concise editorial hierarchy rather than decorative nostalgia.
activeTrends.layout: Use magazine column rhythm, purposeful margins, an intimate crop and one short factual pull-line beside the product. In Video, reveal type line by line at a natural reading pace.
activeTrends.typography: High-contrast editorial serif with a neutral sans; accurate punctuation and generous leading.
activeTrends.palette: Warm white, ink black, muted brand color and one restrained accent.
activeTrends.texture: Book paper, letterpress impression or soft photographic grain.
activeTrends.avoid: Long unreadable paragraphs, vintage cosplay and decorative fake handwriting.

activeTrends.label: Restrained Stripe Architecture
activeTrends.signal: Pinterest Predicts 2026’s FunHaus signal supports expressive stripes and sculptural shapes; simplify it into one directional architecture that improves navigation.
activeTrends.layout: Use one stripe system to guide the eye from headline to product to 1–3 information modules, with controlled foreground and background depth. In Video, let the stripes drive one clean directional transition.
activeTrends.typography: Strong simple display type aligned to the stripe rhythm.
activeTrends.palette: Two brand-compatible colors plus white or a quiet neutral.
activeTrends.texture: Flat print color or believable painted/set-built surfaces.
activeTrends.avoid: Circus literalism, rainbow clutter, warped products and optical noise behind text.

globalAvoid: copying a specific Pinterest pin, Instagram post, creator, brand campaign or composition
trend stacking or forcing a trend that weakens two-second clarity, product fidelity or coherence
generic AI gloss, cinematic packshot treatment or dark styling unless explicitly requested
fake fonts, warped glyphs, gibberish or unreadable microtext
product deformation, label reconstruction, recoloring or relighting inside the product silhouette
invented product claims, unsupported benefits, ingredients, numbers, certifications or offers
collages, grids, contact sheets or multi-output boards unless explicitly requested
excessive text, crowded or disconnected modules, random stickers or shapes and gradients without purpose
repeated templates, perfect template symmetry, empty minimalism or simplistic product-plus-headline layouts
more than two font families, more than three weights or competing typographic systems
flat compositions without useful information design, tactile detail or deliberate foreground/background depth
